narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Improvement opportunities are ranked with the six-factor priority formula: Priority = 0.25 x Business Impact + 0.20 x Risk Exposure + 0.20 x Competitive Gap + 0.15 x Effort-Inverse + 0.10 x Quick-Win + 0.10 x Trend-Momentum, each factor scored 1-10. All 17 categories fall in the MEDIUM tier (4.3-5.75): there are no catch-up CRITICALs because Elliott is above peer median everywhere, so the ranking instead sequences leapfrog opportunities. The top five are Servicing (5.75), Personalization (5.50), Compliance & Surveillance (5.35), Onboarding (5.30) and Data Management (5.20) — three of the top five sit in the weakest pillar (P2), confirming the client-experience layer as the primary focus and the Data Cloud foundation as its enabler.
narrative.recommendations_md: Nine recommendations follow — eight Zennify-delivered and one client-owned — each traced to root-cause evidence, validated as a confirmed technology absence (connector re-validated June 2026 via Explorium match-business, Exa and Dice), aligned to at least one stated Elliott strategic objective, and framed as complementary unification above the proprietary platform (E-018), never displacement. Expected outcomes are expressed as maturity deltas and qualitative impact only; no cost, ROI or timeline figures are asserted (Rule R6).
narrative.roadmap_md:
The roadmap sequences by dependency and maturity milestone, not by calendar — no durations or timelines are asserted (Rule R6). Each wave begins only when its predecessor's data and integration milestone is met.
Wave 1 — Foundation
Initiatives: Data Cloud (enterprise data unification) + MuleSoft (integration fabric)
Milestone: A single governed data foundation and API-led connectivity across prime brokers, custodians and fund administrators — the prerequisite for every downstream capability. Advances toward level 4 and toward level 3+.
Wave 2 — Engagement
Initiatives: Agentforce + Experience Cloud (LP/IR system of engagement) + FSC / Sales Cloud (investor relationship management)
Milestone: An LP self-service portal and a 360-degree relationship system of record, running on the Wave-1 foundation. Advances toward level 3+/level 4 and toward level 3+.
Wave 3 — Intelligence & Expansion
Initiatives: Campaign Intelligence + Disclosure & Surveillance Data + Analytics & AI
Milestone: Campaign and stakeholder intelligence, governed disclosure lineage, and enterprise analytics/AI on the unified dataset. Advances, and.
Cross-cutting — Strategy & Ownership
Initiatives: Digital Strategy & Operating Model + data/AI leadership (client-owned)
Milestone: Anchors and governs the sequence throughout, converting an implicit, investment-led strategy into an explicit, owned operating model.
